0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010010_SHALE
0.description: Ah, you're just in time for a progress report.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010020_SHALE
1.description: The decryption is finally complete. As we suspected, the data represents a partial record of Preservation's research documents.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010030_SHALE
2.description: A quick scan of the files, however, failed to turn up the information Y'shtola was after.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010032_YSHTOLA
3.description: Indeed. No mention of the Ascians─or primal summoning techniques, for that matter.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010034_YSHTOLA
4.description: While Calyx doubtless received instruction from someone possessed of such knowledge, there was naught to identify this benevolent mentor.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010036_YSHTOLA
5.description: I am however pleased to say that we found several reports concerning the key.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010040_SHALE
6.description: We know the key is used to open paths between worlds, and was a treasured relic of the Milalla.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010050_SHALE
7.description: And just as the Milalla were unable to return after reaching the Mist Continent, so too was Preservation unable to gain a mastery of the prize which had passed into their possession.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010051_SHALE
8.description: The data suggests that a particular formula or procedure is required...

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010052_SHALE
9.description: A process which Calyx appears to have understood to some degree.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010054_SHALE
11.description: Perfectly replicating conditions was no guarantee of success. And even when they did manage to generate a modest portal, the destination was never the one they expected.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010055_SHALE
12.description: The reports practically screamed their frustration, describing the experience as being dragged around by a traveler picking roads without rhyme or reason. Serves them right, I say.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010060_YSHTOLA
13.description: After much trial and error, Preservation began to experiment with external actuation devices for the key.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010070_YSHTOLA
14.description: Striving to maintain a stable pathway to a chosen location, they conceived of the technology that forms the gate to the golden city.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010100_GRAHATIA
15.description: So their tribulations ultimately afforded them control of the key─albeit in a limited capacity...

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010101_GRAHATIA
16.description: Which, of course, explains why they were able to instruct Zoraal Ja in its use.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010102_GRAHATIA
17.description: Thus enabling the unprecedented feat of transferring Everkeep and its environs to the Source.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010103_GRAHATIA
18.description: After the Endless Sphene took the key unto herself, she opened pathways to other reflections in her hunt for aether, did she not?

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010104_KRILE
19.description: The Milalla merely used it to facilitate their exodus. To think what the key has now wrought in different hands...

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010105_GRAHATIA
20.description: For all we know, the actuation device augmented the key's power beyond its intended scope.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010106_GRAHATIA
21.description: Were your goal to plunder whole worlds of their aether, a tool designed to simply transfer people would likely be insufficient.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010107_KRILE
22.description: Shale, I don't suppose you would be able to remove the actuation device?

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010110_SHALE
23.description: The machine made for that very purpose is still functional, thankfully. It shouldn't be a problem.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010112_KRILE
24.description: What do you think? We don't even know how the key works─if the device is somehow interfering or amplifying its capabilities, I believe we ought to remove it.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010160_YSHTOLA
28.description: This is the first time I've beheld the key in all its unobscured glory.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010170_YSHTOLA
29.description: The sheer density is extraordinary... 'Tis akin to the structures we saw beneath the Tempest.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010172_GRAHATIA
30.description: Now that you mention it, the ornamentation <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> reminiscent of Amaurot.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010174_KRILE
31.description: Have you noticed anything since the key has been in your possession?

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_A7_000_001_NONE_VOICE
33.description: It gleams like the dawn's first light...

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_A7_000_002_NONE_VOICE
34.description: It reminds me of Azem's crystal.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010180_YSHTOLA
35.description: You're suggesting the key has some connection with Azem?

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010190_YSHTOLA
36.description: A plausible theory. Although one we are yet unequipped to prove.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010210_KRILE
38.description: Hello? Yes, this is Krile speaking.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010212_KRILE
39.description: That was Ojika with a message for us.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010224_KRILE
42.description: Tataru requires our counsel, and hoped to call upon us in person at the Baldesion Annex.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010226_KRILE
43.description: Though disappointed we were not present, she appeared content to wait until our travels brought us back to Sharlayan, insisting that it did not merit our immediate summons.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010228_KRILE
44.description: Her tone suggested otherwise, however, and Ojika felt compelled to contact us directly.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010230_GRAHATIA
45.description: Mayhap the time has come for another journey across the salt.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010231_SHALE
46.description: You'd best go. Though I'll not deny that I'll be sad to see you leave...

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010232_KRILE
47.description: Oh, Shale. I can't even begin to thank you for all you've done.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010233_KRILE
48.description: We will be forever indebted to you and your Oblivion colleagues.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010234_SHALE
49.description: The debt is ours. We'll never forget the sacrifices you've made for us─for Alexandria.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010235_SHALE
50.description: In the meantime, I shall keep sifting through the data. You'll hear as soon as I find anything of note.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010240_YSHTOLA
51.description: Actually, I should like to stay here a little longer, if you don't mind?

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010250_YSHTOLA
53.description: And might I borrow the key for a while? I wish to study it further─with the utmost care, I assure you.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010260_KRILE
54.description: Well then, shall we be off? Ojika will be expecting us!

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000014_KRILE
57.description: Thinking back to when you bought this map─and how you all encouraged me to make the voyage to Tural...

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_A6_000_001_NONE_VOICE
62.description: Wonderful to see you again, Tataru!

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000070_GRAHATIA
65.description: Ojika contacted us. He intimated that you were rather concerned.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000072_GRAHATIA
66.description: Come to think of it, Alphinaud said he and Alisaie would pay you a visit upon their return. Have you not seen them?

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000080_TATARU
67.description: Oh, no, they were here! I was regaled with many a tale of your Turali adventures.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000082_TATARU
68.description: It was only once they'd departed for Garlemald that the rumors came to my attention.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000090_TATARU
69.description: Rather alarmingly, voidsent sightings seem to be on the rise across the star.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000100_TATARU
70.description: I was reluctant to bother you with mere hearsay, especially when you had more pressing matters to contend with...

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000101_TATARU
71.description: But earlier I received a confidential report from the Grand Company of Eorzea.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000102_TATARU
72.description: It's as if a mighty dam has been breached, flooding the land with foul creatures!

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000103_TATARU
73.description: For a blessing, most nations have managed to keep the invaders in check, and casualties appear to be minimal thus far. Though the same cannot be said for those regions with a deeper connection to the void...

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000104_TATARU
74.description: There, fissures continue to manifest without end, putting countless innocents in danger!

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000105_KRILE
75.description: A deeper connection to the void...

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000106_KRILE
76.description: Garlemald is the home of the reapers, is it not?

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000112_TATARU
77.description: It is! Alphinaud and Alisaie were there when the trouble began and have since sent word that the situation has taken a dreadful turn...

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010400_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
78.description: A short while earlier, in Tertium...

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010410_ALPHINAUD
79.description: ...Thus concludes the abridged account of our time in Tural. Now, I shall leave you with the words of the late Dawnservant, Gulool Ja Ja.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010430_ALPHINAUD
81.description: A notion that rings true for Eorzeans no less than it does for the diverse peoples of Tuliyollal.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010440_ALISAIE
82.description: And for Garleans as well. Even sharing something as simple as a local dish can pave avenues of understanding.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010450_ALISAIE
83.description: It's up to all of us to forge new bonds─together.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010460_JULLUS
84.description: Thank you for sharing your tale.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010470_JULLUS
85.description: Better they hear it firsthand than endure my clumsy retelling.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010480_JULLUS
86.description: Your words give me hope that we might achieve something similar here in Garlemald.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010490_ALISAIE
87.description: We all have the capacity to effect change! Our time in Tural taught us that much.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010500_ALISAIE
88.description: And now that we've returned, it's time we rolled up our sleeves and got back to work!

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010510_ALPHINAUD
89.description: I've already sent missives to the other nations informing them of our Alexandrian friends.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010520_ALPHINAUD
90.description: I also intend to notify the Garlean community officially. If both sides are amenable to the proposition, we shall gladly assist in establishing diplomatic relations with Alexandria and Tuliyollal.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010540_JULLUS
92.description: But are you sure you've recovered from your journey? It sounded like you've hardly had time to catch your breath...

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010560_SOLDIERA
94.description: Lapis Manalis is overrun with voidsent! We've sustained heavy civilian casualties!

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010580_SOLDIERB
96.description: (-Imperial Soldier-)Clyteum squadron reporting in. We're under attack!

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010590_SOLDIERB
97.description: (-Imperial Soldier-)Voidsent appeared out of nowhere and ambushed us during a routine inspection!

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010610_JULLUS
99.description: My comrades are under attack. We have to do something.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010620_ALISAIE
100.description: There's no time to lose. Come on!

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000140_TATARU
101.description: The Garlean community is ill-equipped to defend themselves against such a threat. Even with the aid of the twins and the Ilsabard contingent, they face daunting odds...

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000150_GRAHATIA
102.description: We shall leave for Garlemald immediately.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000154_TATARU
104.description: I was able to contact Thancred and Urianger too─they're already on their way. With any luck, you'll be able to rendezvous with them on arrival!

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000170_THANCRED
105.description: You picked a frosty spot for a reunion.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000172_ALPHINAUD
106.description: Tataru sent word that you were coming. Full glad am I to see you all.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000174_ALPHINAUD
107.description: Though I'm afraid this is no time for pleasantries...

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000180_ALPHINAUD
108.description: Planar fissures have opened up across Garlemald, inundating the region with voidsent. As far as we can ascertain, there are two focal points of their assault.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000190_ALPHINAUD
109.description: The Ilsabard contingent are combating the threat in Lapis Manalis. Although they have suffered casualties, they appear to have the upper hand.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000200_URIANGER
110.description: As well they should. The many talented Ul'dahn thaumaturges among them should be more than capable of closing any fissures they encounter.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000210_ALISAIE
111.description: Which leaves the second focal point: the Clyteum. Jullus and the Garlean community are attempting to mount a counterattack, but are struggling to cope with the sheer number of voidsent.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000220_ALISAIE
112.description: They've fallen back to the north of the imperial palace. Can you lend your aid in securing the area?

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000230_KRILE
113.description: With your blessing, I would tend to the wounded returning from battle.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000250_ALPHINAUD
115.description: The quickest route from here to the front is via the train tracks. Once we arrive, we can support the Garlean forces as we make for the fissure in the munitions factory.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000260_JULLUS
116.description: I think that's all of them.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000270_URIANGER
117.description: We need but seal the fissure to prevent further ingress.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000272_JULLUS
119.description: I can only imagine the extent of the damage were it not for your aid. On behalf of the Garlean community, I thank you for all you've done for my people─for my home.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000278_URIANGER
122.description: I shall close the fissure posthaste.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000290_PUPPETEERVOIDCENT
124.description: If you do that, I will be trapped here...

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000295_JULLUS
125.description: You risked your life in vanquishing the creature─would you at least let me bear the burden of deciding its fate?

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000300_JULLUS
126.description: You want to go back? To the void?

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000320_JULLUS
128.description: Your kind have entered this realm before. Some seeking death that they might rejoin the Lifestream.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000330_JULLUS
129.description: But you would choose that dark, deathless place?

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000360_PUPPETEERVOIDCENT
130.description: The wind here is fresh and pure, untouched by Darkness. Perhaps it would be a blessing to meet my end in such a place.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000370_PUPPETEERVOIDCENT
131.description: But I cannot yet bear to part with the void. If only the winds would blow there as they do here...

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000380_PUPPETEERVOIDCENT
132.description: I long to return... To see my home unsullied, as it once was.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000390_JULLUS
133.description: We know that pain all too well.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000400_JULLUS
134.description: If that is your wish, you must forsake this aggression, go back to the void, and devote yourself to its restoration.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000440_JULLUS
135.description: I have a friend...Zero, who hails from your home. She and her companions strive to bring Light into the void from another world blighted with imbalance.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000450_JULLUS
136.description: I hear their efforts have already met with some success. One day, they'll drive the Darkness from the void─I'm sure of it.

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000510_PUPPETEERVOIDCENT
137.description: This form...is imbued with the will of all those I have consumed.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000520_PUPPETEERVOIDCENT
138.description: We shall return to our world and seek out this “Zero.” Then we shall see if there is truth in your words.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000530_JULLUS
139.description: She won't disappoint you. That much I guarantee.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000532_ALISAIE
140.description: Bravo! I think Zero will approve!

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000560_ALPHINAUD
142.description: Indeed. That was truly heartening to see!

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000566_JULLUS
145.description: I thought I might lead by example.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000574_THANCRED
148.description: Well then, shall we head back?

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000630_THANCRED
149.description: The Ilsabard contingent have contained the threat on their front. Things appear to be under control for the time being.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000640_THANCRED
150.description: Though it remains unclear why the fissures opened up in the first place. According to Tataru, similar ruptures are occurring across the star.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000650_GRAHATIA
151.description: One thing <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> clear, however: the phenomenon is not without pattern.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000655_GRAHATIA
152.description: The tendency for fissures to emerge is pronounced in regions deeply connected to the void─places where the barrier between the two worlds is at its thinnest.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000680_URIANGER
154.description: ...I fear there may be a place in far greater peril than Garlemald.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000690_URIANGER
155.description: Though it hath since been sealed, you will recall there is a great voidgate that we ourselves had cause to open.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000695_URIANGER
156.description: A gate which was instrumental in our bid to reunite Vrtra with his sister and put an end to Golbez's dark plot.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000720_URIANGER
158.description: With our attention fixed upon planar fissures, I failed to consider this vulnerability. All other paths unto the void are but pinpricks in the veil compared to that great lunar rift...

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000730_THANCRED
159.description: And that rift might be yawning open as we speak. We'd better hurry.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000740_URIANGER
160.description: Let us make for Bestways Burrow. I daresay the Loporrits are well aware of current events.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000750_GRAHATIA
161.description: We ought to have Krile join us once she finishes tending to the wounded.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000760_GRAHATIA
162.description: I shall likewise contact Y'shtola. Her knowledge of the moon's voidgate is second to none.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000770_JULLUS
163.description: Alphinaud, Alisaie, please do what you must to keep our world safe.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000780_JULLUS
164.description: A number of my fellow Garleans now call Mare Lamentorum home... Alphinaud, Alisaie, please see they come to no harm.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000790_ALISAIE
165.description: We'll be back before you know it!

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000800_JULLUS
166.description: A quick word, if you will.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000810_JULLUS
167.description: I'm not sure whether you'll run into Zero during the course of all this, but if you do...would you give this to her?

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000820_JULLUS
168.description: Emergency rations, in case of a protracted battle. Can't imagine she's eating all that well in the void.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000823_URIANGER
173.description: Given thy panicked state, I presume the Loporrits too are beset with voidsent...

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000824_MAPPINGWAY
174.description: Oh, what sweet relief it is to see you all!

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000825_MAPPINGWAY
175.description: Yes, voidsent─and lots of them! They suddenly came pouring forth from the crater!

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000826_URIANGER
176.description: I had dearly hoped to find my worries unfounded...

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000827_MAPPINGWAY
177.description: For some unknown reason, the voidgate seems to have partially opened.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010800_MAPPINGWAY
178.description: Livingway dashed off to activate the brands and halt the fiends' invasion...

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_010810_MAPPINGWAY
179.description: But she hasn't come back, and we've since lost contact!

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000828_URIANGER
180.description: I suggest we make for the brands without delay.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000840_LIVINGWAY
182.description: I'm saved! I dread to think what would have befallen me if you hadn't intervened!

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000850_LIVINGWAY
183.description: Oh, I was never in any real danger, of course! I knew you would realize our plight and rush to our rescue!

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000860_LIVINGWAY
184.description: Etheirys is likewise plagued with voidsent?

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000870_LIVINGWAY
185.description: If only we'd prioritized further development of the voidsent slaughter-bots. We could have stemmed the tide ourselves!

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000872_LIVINGWAY
186.description: Oh, what a tremendous demonstration that would have been. Irrefutable proof that I was mankind's staunchest ally, and the greatest Loporrit to ever live! I can practically taste the praise!

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000890_LIVINGWAY
188.description: Fortunately, I was able to activate the brands. Should any more voidsent emerge from the gate, they ought to be confined to the crater.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000900_LIVINGWAY
189.description: Unless, of course, the voidgate begins to expand of its own accord, or some gargantuan monstrosity tries to barge through, I don't foresee any major problems...

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000922_YSHTOLA
192.description: I left the data in Shale's capable hands and teleported here as soon as I heard.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000924_YSHTOLA
193.description: And ere you ask, I made sure to bring the key with me.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000930_GRAHATIA
194.description: Then the real threat yet awaits us.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000950_YSHTOLA
196.description: I wonder how he and Zero are faring.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000964_MYSTERIOUSVOICE
199.description: Yours is a journey without end, conceived and guided by principle.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000970_MYSTERIOUSVOICE
200.description: Hold fast to what you must, and meet your fate without fear.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_000980_MYSTERIOUSVOICE
201.description: Go forth. Discover. Unite the stars unto one.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001030_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
209.description: Only you could be so carefree amidst all this...

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001040_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
210.description: Trust you to state the obvious.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001050_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
211.description: May as well make yourself useful.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001060_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
212.description: The gate's sheer size appears to have made it a tempting target.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001070_BLACKKNIGHT
213.description: Enuo... A dread voidsent risen from the benighted depths of the ocean.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001080_BLACKKNIGHT
214.description: They kept to the confines of their domain while Zeromus endured. No longer, it would seem.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001090_BLACKKNIGHT
215.description: And once they had discovered a path to the red moon, they wasted no time in making the journey.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001100_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
216.description: Leave the voidsent nearby to us. You take care of Enuo!

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001102_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
217.description: Facing this many foes calls for a more...familiar approach.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001104_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
218.description: Voidsent can change their form at will─both Light and Darkness are mine to wield.

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001106_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
219.description: Besides, what better to purge Darkness from the void than Darkness itself!

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001110_ENUO
222.description: Who dares face me? A mere mortal?

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001120_ENUO
223.description: Hast thou come in search of power? Renown?

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001130_ENUO
224.description: I fight to end this world without end! All who stand before me shall fall!

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001140_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
229.description: I'm glad you came. We would have struggled to face Enuo alone.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001150_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
230.description: I presume you journeyed here to prevent more voidsent from passing through the gate?

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001170_BLACKKNIGHT
231.description: With Enuo defeated, there are none left in this realm who pose a serious threat. I daresay the problem is resolved.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
233.description: Alas, voidsent have been emerging from fissures across the Source...

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
234.description: Have you noticed any abnormalities in the void of late?

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001180_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
235.description: Cause for alarm, indeed. Tell us more.

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001190_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
236.description: Nothing comes to mind. Why do you ask?

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001192_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
237.description: So the breach wasn't limited to the voidgate...

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001194_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
238.description: For better or worse, precious little has changed in the Thirteenth since Zeromus fell.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001200_BLACKKNIGHT
240.description: I know not the reason events have unfolded this way, but there is, perhaps, an explanation as to why the voidgate and the fissures opened.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001205_BLACKKNIGHT
241.description: Here in my domain, even the slightest change is keenly felt...

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001210_BLACKKNIGHT
242.description: When the gate opened, I sensed not the workings of some external force.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001215_BLACKKNIGHT
243.description: Rather, it felt as if the barrier between our worlds was weakening naturally, moment by moment, until the two came to meet.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001220_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
244.description: And you think this...weakening could be happening elsewhere?

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001240_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
247.description: Jullus took mercy upon the interloper?

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001250_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
249.description: Whether voidsent or Garlean, we all share the same longing for home.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001260_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
250.description: Should we meet, I will gladly offer them aid. Please tell Jullus as much.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001270_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
252.description: Wait─how exactly did you get here? No mortal could traverse the voidgate in its current state.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001280_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
253.description: And this path of yours is still there...? I cannot see it.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001290_BLACKKNIGHT
254.description: Nor does it reveal itself to me. Perhaps the path serves only the key-bearer.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001300_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
255.description: So it is not a means to travel freely back and forth. A pity. I would have liked to see my friends again...

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001310_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
256.description: Upon activation, these transmitters will shine with Light from beyond─sent courtesy of our ever-watchful friends.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001320_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
257.description: They will serve as beacons in the Dark for those that would seek me out.

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001340_PUPPETEERVOIDCENT
259.description: And a mortal, no less. I did not expect to see you here.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001350_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
260.description: I am Zero, and this is my domain. 'Tis a safe haven for those who abhor conflict.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001360_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
261.description: Among those gathered here, many aspire to restore this world to how it once was.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001380_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
263.description: Indeed. Though how long the endeavor will take, I cannot say.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001390_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
264.description: But for those of us abandoned by death itself, what do we have but time to try, and try again?

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001410_PUPPETEERVOIDCENT
266.description: This Light is ample proof your comrade spoke true. However long it takes to restore our world, you shall have my aid.

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001430_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
268.description: Would you deliver a message to Jullus for me? Tell him that we're making progress towards rebuilding our home...and I hope that he is too.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001440_BLACKKNIGHT
269.description: Enuo's memoria will be safe here.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001450_BLACKKNIGHT
270.description: The crystal containing Zeromus has been passed on to our allies in the First...

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001460_BLACKKNIGHT
271.description: If Enuo's memoria might serve them in restoring their world, we shall likewise consider its transfer.

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001470_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
272.description: How much simpler it would be to aid one another in our respective fights, were it not for these boundaries between us...

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001480_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
273.description: Safe travels, my friend. We take comfort in the knowledge that you're out there fighting too, wherever you may be.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001512_THANCRED
274.description: No luck, I'm afraid. It appears <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503>'s not in Mare Lamentorum.

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001540_ALISAIE
276.description: Gods, you had us worried! You suddenly disappeared─we didn't know what to think.

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001542_ALPHINAUD
277.description: Shortly after you vanished, the voidsent incursion abruptly ended.

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001544_ALPHINAUD
278.description: We surmised you had a hand in that, but never did it cross our minds that you were fighting alongside Zero and Golbez.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001550_KRILE
279.description: This golden path you said you traversed wasn't visible to us either.

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001552_KRILE
280.description: Nor did we hear a voice. “Ethos”... Might this be the key's true name?

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001560_YSHTOLA
281.description: While many mysteries remain, for now I am glad to learn the state of affairs in the Thirteenth.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001562_YSHTOLA
282.description: Golbez's suspicion that the barrier 'twixt worlds has begun to weaken...

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001564_YSHTOLA
283.description: 'Twould certainly explain the surge in fissures manifesting in the Source.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001566_URIANGER
284.description: Yet what could be behind such a phenomenon?

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001568_THANCRED
285.description: And who might you be? Not a voidsent, I'd wager.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001570_HALMARUT
287.description: I am Halmarut of the Ascians.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001571_HALMARUT
288.description: We are your sworn foes, I know. But on this occasion, will you not put away your arms?

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001573_HALMARUT
290.description: Thank you for affording me a chance.

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001574_YSHTOLA
291.description: Bereft of the unsundered, we were under the impression you and yours no longer had cause to continue your activities.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001575_YSHTOLA
292.description: That you should reveal yourself at this juncture...

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001576_YSHTOLA
293.description: I assume you are the one who bestowed Calyx with the knowledge of summoning and the reflections.

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001582_CALYX
296.description: ...Was it necessary to reveal my present form as well?

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001590_GRAHATIA
297.description: Calyx! So he succeeded in transferring his memories after all...

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001610_CALYX
298.description: Be at ease. Even were I to occupy a combat-oriented vessel, I would not have the ability to defeat you.

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001620_CALYX
299.description: You destroyed my plan─my life's work. I have naught to replace it, nor will I ever regain what I once had.

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001622_ALPHINAUD
300.description: If you wish to speak, Halmarut, will you not tell us what it is that you hope to accomplish?

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001640_HALMARUT
301.description: As you know, our star, Etheirys, was sundered into four and ten shards in the time of the ancients.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001660_HALMARUT
302.description: As the will of the star, Hydaelyn perpetuated this unnatural division for millennia.

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001670_HALMARUT
303.description: And in the wake of Her passing, nature has begun to reassert itself. As a wound knits itself together, the star seeks to become whole once more.

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001672_HALMARUT
304.description: Yes, it seeks to rejoin with all of its shards.

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001690_HALMARUT
305.description: Unlike the one we Ascians attempted to orchestrate, however, the star's rejoining will afford mankind no special treatment.

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001700_HALMARUT
306.description: All life and matter will be condensed into a single whole and remade for a new beginning. A complete rebirth.

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001710_HALMARUT
307.description: Etheirys will return to the way it once was, hundreds of millions of years past. To a quiet and peaceful time, long before the light of mankind was kindled.

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001712_ALISAIE
308.description: Supposing for a moment we believe you, how can you possibly know all this?

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001714_HALMARUT
309.description: It is an inevitability that I have foreseen since time immemorial.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001716_HALMARUT
310.description: A future that awaits should creation be freed from the influence of Hydaelyn and Zodiark.

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001730_HALMARUT
311.description: The star is tolerant to life. It holds no grudges, and neither rages nor weeps for being sundered.

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001740_HALMARUT
312.description: Yet by the same token, it is indifferent to life's survival. No amount of devastation and death can compel it to stop the wheels of creation from turning.

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001750_HALMARUT
313.description: The earth shakes, and mountains spew fire. Floods wash away the fruits of labor, and icy winds freeze and starve. Countless perish as nature runs its course.

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001760_HALMARUT
314.description: So many seeds of life have already been lost. Yet in spite of this, people continue to believe that the morrow will come.

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001762_HALMARUT
315.description: But it will not. For nothing lies beyond the Solstice, when all creation is reunited. When that day comes, every last trace of mankind shall be erased.

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001810_HALMARUT
317.description: Despite losing his innocence and being made to live with suffering, he has forged ever onward. Strong even as he is weak, his is a proud tale in the history of the star.

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001820_HALMARUT
318.description: 'Twould be a shame for that tale to end. For all to wither and die when some might yet survive. Would you not agree?

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001824_URIANGER
320.description: If a natural rejoining doth lead unto the Solstice, then thine intent is to preemptively rejoin the worlds.

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001880_CALYX
321.description: Correct. It was for this very purpose that Halmarut recruited suitable collaborators from the reflections.

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001890_CALYX
322.description: Individuals like me, who would willingly doom another world in order to fulfill their aspirations.

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001892_CALYX
323.description: The Winterers, we are called. And if you and yours seek to protect all life, then sooner or later, you shall have to contend with us.

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001894_KRILE
324.description: Even if everything you claim <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> true...

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001896_KRILE
325.description: What you've done, Calyx... It's unforgivable!

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001900_HALMARUT
326.description: I do not ask that you be pragmatic, nor do I seek your approval.

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001902_HALMARUT
327.description: Given your familiarity with other reflections, 'tis only natural that you are averse to our methods.

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001920_HALMARUT
328.description: But there is one irrefutable fact that you must understand.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001922_HALMARUT
329.description: Should we take no action at all, the Solstice will come. And no one will be left alive. No one.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001930_HALMARUT
330.description: Of course, should it serve to satisfy your ambition, you are welcome to deal with the reflections as you deem fit.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001940_HALMARUT
331.description: Like the pariah and wanderer who satisfied his own, when he brought the star to the brink of ruin to face you.

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001944_URIANGER
333.description: Long it hath been since last we gathered here...

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001946_URIANGER
334.description: Though our order's dissolution was indeed in name only, thereafter we did largely operate independent of one another.

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001948_URIANGER
335.description: All of which is to say, full glad am I to stand in such esteemed company once more.

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001970_HOARYBOULDER
337.description: We're reporting for duty as bid!

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001980_TATARU
338.description: This is everyone that we could round up on short notice. The others are still en route.

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001982_TATARU
339.description: Estinien alone, we weren't able to make contact with...but we're working on it!

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001984_THANCRED
340.description: No doubt his linkpearl is buried at the bottom of his bag.

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_001990_ALPHINAUD
341.description: Knowing him, he'll turn up when we least expect it.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002040_HOARYBOULDER
342.description: Now, as much as I would like to savor our reunion, Tataru tells us there have been <hex:021A020203>developments<hex:021A020103>.

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002042_HOARYBOULDER
343.description: Will you apprise us of the details?

345.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002400_YSHTOLA
345.description: The veracity of Halmarut's claims remains unclear.

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002410_YSHTOLA
346.description: Yet it cannot be denied that, in his bid to convert the living into Endless, Calyx was privy to knowledge of the reflections and more.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002420_HOARYBOULDER
347.description: And the Winterers are formed of others like him...

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002430_ALPHINAUD
348.description: In light of the recent voidsent incursions, I believe it would be wise to treat the Solstice as a genuine threat.

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002440_ALPHINAUD
349.description: The problem is how to deal with it...

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002450_ALISAIE
350.description: Both the Source and the reflections are home to irreplaceable life. I would protect them all if I could.

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002460_ALISAIE
351.description: But if doing so means ushering in complete annihilation...

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002470_ALISAIE
352.description: Then what can we possibly do?

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002480_KRILE
353.description: I wonder, was Hydaelyn aware of the Solstice?

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002500_GRAHATIA
355.description: Given that we had no knowledge of it when you journeyed to Elpis, you couldn't have warned Venat.

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002510_GRAHATIA
356.description: So it is entirely possible She was unaware. But in the course of sustaining the sundered star, She may have glimpsed this eventuality.

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_A4_000_001_NONE_VOICE
358.description: I don't think She had any way of knowing.

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_A4_000_002_NONE_VOICE
359.description: I think She knew─and chose to trust in us.

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002520_GRAHATIA
360.description: Indeed, not even Hydaelyn could be expected to foresee everything. And with Her gone, we have only speculation.

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002530_GRAHATIA
361.description: So She believed that we could overcome this trial as well? Or rather, that the choice was ours to make...

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002540_YSHTOLA
362.description: Whichever it may be, it is we who must find the answer.

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002550_YSHTOLA
363.description: We who live in the here and now.

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002560_TATARU
364.description: Perhaps we could take a recess? I daresay everyone could use a rest.

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002570_ALPHINAUD
365.description: ...Indeed. We have ample food for thought, and it would be good to catch each other up.

366.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002580_YSHTOLA
366.description: Ere I forget... Hereon, I believe you should keep the key─Ethos─in your possession.

367.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002590_YSHTOLA
367.description: After all, it seems that is one mystery I am not destined to unravel.

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002150_HALMARUT
368.description: Of course, should it serve to satisfy your ambition, you are welcome to deal with the reflections as you deem fit.

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002155_HALMARUT
369.description: Like the pariah and wanderer who satisfied his own, when he brought the star to the brink of ruin to face you.

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002170_CALYX
370.description: (-???-)I detest evenings such as this. Too bright, too stimulating. The mind distracted by the inconsequential.

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002180_CALYX
371.description: You needn't be so wary. I merely come to offer information before my departure.

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002190_CALYX
372.description: Halmarut and I will soon cross the rift to observe the enactment of another Winterer's plan.

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002210_CALYX
374.description: A world locked in ice, whose lands are blanketed in thick clouds. In order to survive, man has fled to the skies, using great magicks to establish new civilizations.

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_A5_000_002_NONE_VOICE
377.description: Why tell me where you're going?

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002212_CALYX
378.description: It was not my intent to excite. I have my own designs I would see realized, nothing more.

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002214_CALYX
379.description: I have my own designs I would see realized, nothing more.

380.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002220_CALYX
380.description: Believe me or don't, as you like. For all I know, you lack the means to follow us anyway.

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002230_CALYX
381.description: What Halmarut said to you earlier...

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002235_CALYX
382.description: She suggested that “dealing with” the reflections might satisfy your ambition. But is that truly so?

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002240_CALYX
383.description: You have seen battles beyond counting. Have defeated even the fear of death. Is there some conclusion that you seek no matter the cost?

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002250_CALYX
384.description: I will share with you a truth.

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002260_CALYX
385.description: We Winterers each have an ambition that we wish to fulfill. To that end, we may share information with one another, but we do not necessarily share the same beliefs.

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002270_CALYX
386.description: Just as you and yours decried my actions, I find those of my fellows objectionable.

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002290_CALYX
388.description: It is the culmination of our lives' works that we would bring to the world─fruits born of undying devotion, daring aspiration, and unwavering ideals.

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002300_CALYX
389.description: No matter how we are reviled, no matter what we must steal, our actions will be vindicated by those who abide in the future we create.

390.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002310_CALYX
390.description: In your benevolence, you may seek to save everything and everyone. But once all is consequently consigned to oblivion...

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07500_002320_CALYX
391.description: Your noble deeds will amount to nothing more than folly. For no living soul shall remain to judge them.
